detail.name: Toggle HUD - Fog - Lens Flare - Bloom - Item Shimmer - Minimal Buddy UI
detail.desc:
This mod allows you to quickly toggle all HUD elements on/off with a single key press (Caps Lock by default, but this can be changed). I've included a few extra toggles:
* F1 - Toggles the item shimmering/highlighting that all characters see.
* F2 - Toggles some of the extra HUD decoration that only shows while playing as Buddy.
* F3 - Toggles the highlighting around interactable items that only shows while playing as Buddy.
* F4 - Toggles Fog.
* F5 - Toggles Bloom and Lens Dirt effects.
* F6 - Toggles Lens Flare effect.
* F7 - Toggles Blur Vignette while aiming, including some of the depth of field on your hands/weapons.

**__INSTALLATION:__**

1. Don't use Mod Organizer 2 to install this, it won't know wtf to do with it.
2. Simply extract the contents of my .zip to this folder (or the EGS equivalent):
__*steamapps\common\CrimeBossRockayCity\CrimeBoss\Binaries\Win64*__
3. Boot up the game and use the keybinds mentioned above!

**__TO CHANGE KEYBINDS:__**

1. Press Home key
2. Go to "Add-ons" tab
3. Under ShaderToggler click the "Edit" button to the left of the toggle you want to rebind
4. Click the box to the right of "Key Shortcut" and then press the key (or controller button) you want to use instead
5. Click "OK" and then "Save all Toggle Groups"

**__TO MAKE A TOGGLE ALWAYS ACTIVE WHEN STARTING THE GAME:__**

1. Press Home key
2. Go to "Add-ons" tab
3. Under ShaderToggler click the "Edit" button to the left of the toggle you want
4. Checkmark "Is active at startup"
5. Click "OK" and then "Save all Toggle Groups"
detail.short_desc: Toggle all HUD on/off (or Buddy the robot's view) with a single key press in Crime Boss: Rockay City
detail.changelog: Fixed Item Shimmer/Highlight toggle, separated Lens Flare and Bloom toggles.
detail.instructions:
* Extract the contents of my Toggle HUD for Crime Boss.zip to this folder (or the EGS equivalent):
*﻿steamapps\common\CrimeBossRockayCity\CrimeBoss\Binaries\Win64*
* Boot up the game and use Caps Lock to toggle the HUD on/off, F1 to toggle minimal Buddy view, and F2 to toggle even more of Buddy's view.
detail.license: Thank you to Frans Bouma for creating the ShaderToggler addon for Reshade, and for giving me permission to include their addon in my toggle HUD mods!

detail.changelog:
**1.0.4**
+ Reduces download file size by removing unnecessary metadata with repak.exe.
+ Corrects left over formatting typo in perk description.
+ Slightly reduces perk bonuses to holster and movement speed for better balance with existing perks
+ Switches Hellflower's class perk to Merc/Hitman instead of Big Shot or Assassin to better support her aggressive playstyle.

**1.0.3**
+ Replaces arms skeletal mesh with a properly made version by Stardrop, fixing all issues with the headpiece blocking field of view in FPP.
+ Adds Hellflower boss skin appearance for the player (Julian asked).
+ Alters colors on Hellflower’s blossoms and Scorpions to fit the name better and visually distinguish them from Volk’s SMG.
+ Adds new character and weapon icons to support the texture changes.
+ Revises Hellflower’s progression screen bio with some info about the origin of her character model from a developer stream.
+ Revises perk descriptions for length and clarity.

**1.0.2**
+ Fixes issue with Hellflower’s eye material instance displaying correctly in TPP.

**1.0.1**
+ Fixes displayed dynamic translation values and strings table text for perk attribute modifiers.
